scientific_integrity.exact_claim: The complete complex-parameter hyponormality locus for the unweighted Bergman Toeplitz symbol \(z+\lambda z^2\overline z\), including an explicit infinite exposed-disk boundary and exact real slice.
limitations: Only the classical unweighted analytic Bergman disk and this two-term polynomial family are covered.
The 2009 Liu–Lu original paper was not inspected in full; its general Mellin criterion is quoted in Fleeman–Liaw (2017).
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_integrity.proof_status: Analytical proof supplied using exact shift coefficients, monotone-slope line envelope and finite-degree polynomial signs.

title: Infinitely many active hyponormality disks for a two-term Bergman Toeplitz symbol
